notes: All 30 source and 34 target ids partitioned once across 28 units.

מֵעֵבֶר לְ is taken as one fused unit under rule 30: the morphemes are contiguous and *beyond* carries every one of their senses, so nothing is left over to mark. The competing split, with the לְ unrepresented, is named in the note.
*were given them* is wholly `added` — verb and indirect object alike, since the Hebrew has neither.
The locative he of יַהְצָה fuses with the name (rule 30) rather than falling under rule 32, which governs paragogic and cohortative he.
*on the east side of the Jordan* renders its rectum arthrously, so the article takes its own written *the* and the construct מִזְרַח a supplied one — the same test as vv.54, 56 and 61.
